subject: maths
question_en:
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the ages of 11 employees. The median age is 34. Find the value of $x$.

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{Stem (10)} & \text{Leaf (1)} \\\hline 2 & 2, 5, 8 \\\ 3 & 1, 3, x, 7 \\\ 4 & 0, 4, 6, 9 \end{array}
$$
question_zh:
下表顯示 11 名員工的年齡。年齡的中位數為 34。求 $x$ 的值。

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{莖 (10)} & \text{葉 (1)} \\\hline 2 & 2, 5, 8 \\\ 3 & 1, 3, x, 7 \\\ 4 & 0, 4, 6, 9 \end{array}
$$
solution_steps_zh: 3. 第 6 個數據是 $30 + x = 34 \implies x = 4$。

subject: maths
question_en:
The stem-and-leaf diagram shows the weights of 10 bags. The range of the weights is 25 kg. Find the value of $y$.

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{Stem (10)} & \text{Leaf (1)} \\\hline 4 & 2, 5, 8 \\\ 5 & 1, 3, 3, 7 \\\ 6 & 0, 4, y \end{array}
$$
question_zh:
下表顯示 10 袋物品的重量。重量的全距為 25 kg。求 $y$ 的值。

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{莖 (10)} & \text{葉 (1)} \\\hline 4 & 2, 5, 8 \\\ 5 & 1, 3, 3, 7 \\\ 6 & 0, 4, y \end{array}
$$

subject: maths
question_en: If the mean mark of 60, 70, 80 with frequencies 5, $k$, 8 is 72, find the value of $k$.
question_zh: 若 60, 70, 80 的頻數分別為 5, $k$, 8 且平均分為 72，求 $k$ 的值。

subject: maths
question_en: If the median of scores 1(4), 2(6), 3(p), 4(5), 5(3) is 3, find the minimum possible value of $p$.
solution_steps_en: 1. Cumulative frequency of scores 1 and 2 is 10.
3. For the median to be 3, the middle position must be $> 10$.
5. If $p=2, n=20$, median is average of 10th (2) and 11th (3) which is 2.5. Not 3.
solution_steps_zh: 1. 1 分及 2 分的累積頻數為 10。
3. 為了使中位數為 3，中間位置必須大於 10。

subject: maths
question_en: A set of 19 values has mean 60. If outlier 140 is removed, find the new mean of the 18 items.
question_zh: 一組 19 個數據平均值為 60。若移除離群值 140，求剩餘 18 項的新平均值。

subject: maths
question_en: The median of 15 numbers is 42. If the largest number is increased by 20, what is the new median?
question_zh: 15 個數字的中位數為 42。若將最大的數字增加 20，新的中位數是多少？
solution_steps_en: 2. Increasing the largest value (the 15th value) does not change the 8th item.
solution_steps_zh: 1. 中位數是排序後的第 8 個數據（42）。
2. 增加最大的數值（第 15 個數據）不會影響第 8 個位置的數據。

subject: maths
question_en: Range was 50, max was 95. If 110 is added, find the new range.
question_zh: 全距為 50，最大值為 95。若加入一個 110，求新的全距。

subject: maths
question_en: If 10 is added to every data point in a set where $Q_1=30, Q_3=60$, find new IQR.
question_zh: 若將組中每個數據都加 10，且已知原 $Q_1=30, Q_3=60$，求新的 IQR。

subject: maths
question_en:
Find $a, b$ in stem-leaf with 10 data points if Mean=57.1 and Median=56.

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{Stem} & \text{Leaf} \\\hline 4 & 5, 8 \\\ 5 & 2, 4, a, b \\\ 6 & 1, 3, 7, 9 \end{array}
$$
question_zh: 10 個數據的幹葉圖中，若平均值為 57.1 且中位數為 56，求 $a$ 及 $b$。
solution_steps_en: 5. If $a=5, b=7$, sorted leaves in Stem 5: [2, 4, 5, 7]. 5th is 55, 6th is 57. Median = 56.
solution_steps_zh: 4. 中位數 56 要求第 5 和第 6 個數據之和為 112。
5. 若 $a=5, b=7$，排序葉子後中位數即為 56。符合所有條件。

question_en: Min=15. Max is 60 more than Min. Find Max and Range.
question_zh: 最小值為 15。最大值比最小值大 60。求最大值及全距。
